overlay.assistantText: The frontend for Moment Diary has been successfully implemented and integrated with the backend static file service.Summary of Changes Backend Integration (src/app.ts):  Added serveStatic middleware from hono/bun to serve files from the public/ directory.  Configured the app to serve index.html as the entry point. Frontend Layout (public/index.html):  Developed a clean, responsive single-page application (SPA) structure.  Included sections for Authentication (Login/Register), Main Dashboard (Diary List), Timeline View, and Modals for creating/editing diaries. Frontend Styling (public/styles.css):  Implemented a modern, minimalist design using CSS variables.  Added specific styles for diary entries, timeline visualization, and interactive elements. Frontend Logic (public/app.js):  Built with pure Vanilla JavaScript (ES Modules).  Authentication: Handles token storage in localStorage (moment_token), automatic login state detection, and protected API calls.  Diary CRUD: Full implementation of creating, reading, updating, and deleting diary entries with immediate UI feedback.  Timeline View: Implemented a separate view with filtering capabilities by tags and moods (happy, sad, neutral, excited, anxious).  API Client: Includes a robust fetch wrapper that automatically handles Bearer tokens and redirects to login on 401 Unauthorized errors.Verification  The application is accessible at http://localhost:3000.  All static files are placed in the public/ directory and exceed the 1KB size requirement.  The backend's existing logic remains untouched, with only the static file service added as requested.
